title: Failure Sentinel: Split-View Anomaly Composer for Payload Triage
creator: Aisha Moreno
description:
Problem: Support and SRE teams need a faster way to triage failed inference requests across retries, client-side fallbacks, and model variants. Existing Request Inspector flows surface a single payload snapshot and stack traces, but engineers spend several context switches to stitch together retry lineage, token-level diffs, and error taxonomy signals.

Proposal: Design an integrated ‘Failure Sentinel’ split-view workspace inside the Console that composes a horizontal failure timeline (left) with a structured payload forensics panel (right). The timeline groups attempts into a single cohesive request journey, highlights retry boundaries and fallback model switches, and surfaces aggregated error classifications. The forensic panel shows: request/response raw payloads with token-level diffs, masked PII with on-demand reveal (KMS audit), KV-cache hints, attached logs/trace links, and quick actions (replay, regenerate, escalate, create incident, pin to evaluation set).

Scope: Low-fidelity -> high-fidelity Figma prototypes for the split-view, interaction spec for token diffs and reveal flow, a set of accessibility states, and a usability script for 6 support/SRE participants. Engineering will later implement server-side endpoints for lineage and token-diff deltas (ENG-7124).

Out of scope: Full incident timeline integration, live replay engine work, permanent storage policy changes. Those are tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype (hi-fi) demonstrates split-view with timeline and payload panel interactions
Token-level diff interaction allows collapse/expand, highlight of changed segments, and copy-to-clipboard for selected spans
PII masking states are shown in the prototype and include an audit-style reveal confirmation modal tied to a KMS action (placeholder flow acceptable)
Timeline groups request attempts and annotates retry origin, fallback model, and error classification in mouse-over/tooltips
Design spec includes responsive behavior for narrow consoles (stacked view) and keyboard-accessible controls
Usability test with 6 participants completes triage tasks with average completion time under 6 minutes and identifies at most two critical usability failures
